title: Pardons Steven Dwight Hammond
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Steven Dwight Hammond as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list includes Steven Dwight Hammond, convicted in the District of Oregon on two counts of using fire to damage or destroy federal property. It records an original prison sentence of 12 months and one day, later amended to 60 months, plus three years of supervised release. The listing does not describe the fire or explain the pardon.

preserved_fields.title: Pardons Steven Dwight Hammond
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Steven Dwight Hammond as part of a clemency list.

notes: The DOJ list identifies Hammond’s two federal-property fire counts and records a 12-month-and-one-day sentence later amended to 60 months, with supervised release. It does not describe the fire, the case circumstances, or a documented pardon rationale.

title: Pardons Alfonso Antonio Costa
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Alfonso Antonio Costa as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list includes Alfonso Antonio Costa, convicted of health care fraud in the Western District of Pennsylvania. It records three years’ probation, one year of home confinement, 100 hours of community service, a $250,000 fine, and $44,579.47 in restitution. The listing confirms the offense and penalties but does not describe the conduct behind the case or the reason for the pardon.

title: Pardons Dustin Laurent Heard
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Dustin Laurent Heard as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list includes Dustin Laurent Heard, convicted in the District of Columbia of voluntary manslaughter and related firearm offenses. It records six manslaughter counts, 11 attempted-manslaughter counts, firearm counts, and a sentence of 151 months, later amended to 36 months of supervised release. The list gives no account of the incident or the reason for clemency.

title: Pardons Topeka Kimberly Sam
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Topeka Kimberly Sam as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list includes Topeka Kimberly Sam, convicted in the Eastern District of Virginia of conspiracy to possess cocaine hydrochloride with intent to distribute. It records a 52-month prison sentence and five years of supervised release. The list identifies the offense and court orders that amended the sentence but does not describe Sam’s role in the case or explain the pardon.

title: Pardons James Harutun Batmasian
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to James Harutun Batmasian as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list includes James Harutun Batmasian, convicted in the Southern District of Florida of willfully failing to pay over tax. It records eight months’ imprisonment and two years of supervised release. The official listing confirms the offense and sentence but does not explain the tax conduct, case circumstances, or why President Trump granted clemency.

title: Pardons Scott Conor Crosby
